messages:
inc-bot: PAGED SRE -> dedpool 'velaris-pool' node gpu-17 reported repeated ECC/AER errors + kernel retries. High tail latency for tenant velaris-prod. Severity: high. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/dedpool-gpu-hw. Please ack.

sara: ack, taking oncall. pulling logs now.

mike: i'm here too — starting triage. are we seeing spot termination or hardware fault?

sara: initial BMC shows multibit ECC on GPU, but cloud provider also flagged a spot reclaim 30s earlier. seems like hardware flake + possible preempt. grabbing kernel oops.

mike: running inspect command:

```
rictl node inspect gpu-node-17 --fields=health,bmc,vmstate
# output: ECC:+2 events, AER: persistent, vmstate: active, tenant: velaris-prod
```

sara: ok. plan: 1) cordon node -> prevent new jobs, 2) evict velaris workloads with graceful drain, 3) reroute velaris traffic to fallback capacity, 4) initiate vendor RMA if hardware fault confirmed.

ops-bot: cordon + drain job queued: `rictl node cordon gpu-node-17` -> success. Drain started. Eviction policy: tenant-aware live migration.

mike: kicking live fallback for Velaris now: updating routing policy to shift 60% traffic to reserved-burst-1 and enable model-variant fallback (redwood-routing: velaris-fallback).

ops-bot: routing update applied. Velaris traffic split -> 60% reserved-burst-1, 40% velaris-pool. Cache warming initiated for reserved-burst-1.

raj: looping in account team — Velaris PM notified. pinged via email and sent interim status.

alice-cs: Velaris on-call confirms user-facing API errors increasing, asking for immediate isolation of tenant and firm ETA. They also want proactive comms.

sara: isolating tenant at shard level per runbook. command used:

```
rictl tenant isolate velaris-prod --target-pool=reserved-burst-1 --kv-warmup=fast --downtime-allowed=false
```

toni: hardware vendor engaged for RMA. earliest replacement ETD 6 hours. attempting hot-swap today if spare on site. Also noticed PCIe CRC retries on node-19; quarantined it as precaution.

mike: tracking actions: [drain node-17, provision reserved-burst-1, warm KV cache, confirm model fallback correctness, customer comms]. Starting migration of active KV entries now.

ops-bot: drain progress: 45% of active sessions migrated, eviction batch 3/7, live-restore TTL 00:05.

sara: observed a second degradation pattern (node-19) so preemptively cordoned. keeping pool capacity headroom.

raj: request ENG-INFRA to enable cross-pool automatic fallback for enterprise customers — this had a bunch of manual steps. tagging infra team.

alice-cs: Velaris requests a formal incident update and asks about credits/compensation. please capture timeline and impact metrics.

mike: created incident record INC-2024-7552. Added initial timeline + impacted customers. tagging legal & support for compensation guidance.

ops-bot: metric alert -> velaris-prod p99 latency breached (baseline 120ms -> current 980ms). Error rate increased 6x.

toni: short-term mitigation: increase batching and enable a lower-latency quantized model on reserved-burst-1 to soak requests. note: this will increase per-token cost.

alice-cs: Velaris approves temporary increased cost if it stabilizes latency. they want us to revert when SLOs are back.

sara: drain complete on node-17, node marked degraded and quarantined. Replacement scheduled with vendor; RMA ticket #RMA-9082 created. continuing to monitor traffic to reserved-burst-1.

mike: handing off monitoring to next oncall @sara-night in 10m. please keep updating INC-2024-7552 with new timestamps and any customer messages.

ops-bot: final alert: no new ECC events on reserved-burst-1. p99 trending down to ~210ms after fallback and batching. Will continue to sample. :thumbsup:

sara: thanks all. follow-ups: postmortem, automation request for cross-pool fallback, and customer-facing summary. Will coordinate with raj and alice-cs.

mike: closing loop for now. good job team — keep escalation open if node-19 shows more errors. :phone:
